name: Ama Ane -My Sweet Sister-
source:
Yuuta was at the airport waiting to welcome his older sister Alice. He had only met her for a few days when his mother remarried overseas three years ago and haven’t had the chance to see her again since then, but they still got along rather well since they frequently chatted on the phone and e-mailed each other.

“I’m here to be your bride♪”

He had been expecting an enjoyable life with his cute sister, but was overwhelmed by the sudden marriage proclamation and pampering beyond his imagination.

“I’ll clean your ears, so rest on my lap~”
“Dinner’s ready. Here, open up~♪”
“Finished your studies? Hehe, have some headpats as a reward”

The sweet days have begun with an older sister who wants to be a bride.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2019/08/01/august-2019-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri~![/url]]
translation:
裕太正在机场等待迎接他的姐姐爱丽丝。三年前母亲在海外再婚时，他只见过她几天，此后就再也没有见过她，但他们仍然相处得很好，经常打电话、发邮件。

“我是来当你的新娘的~”

他本来期待着和可爱的妹妹过上幸福的生活，却被突如其来的婚讯和超乎想象的宠爱所淹没。

“我来给你清理耳朵，你在我腿上休息吧~”
“晚饭好了。来，开门吧~♪”
“学业完成了？呵呵，奖励一下吧”

想要成为新娘的姐姐开始了甜蜜的日子。

[来自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2019/08/01/august-2019-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri~![/url]]
